title: When the project asks for more

captions.energy: Wanting it to bear more fruit

meaning: Developing a shared idea comes naturally, while emotional attachment to invested effort can make deciding freely to stop more difficult.
text: Creating something together can feel more rewarding than simply discussing a future result. The Empress in the physical position of Manipura appears through actions that produce objects, solutions and visible changes. The Empress in energy gives a wish to keep developing: you want to discover what else your idea could become. The Devil in emotions shows a vulnerable attachment to what you have gained and invested. While the undertaking grows, that feeling can be compelling. It can also make stopping almost unthinkable, even once the original aim has been reached.

For example, you restore an old chest of drawers together. First you intended to replace the handles, then chose paint, and now you are discussing the inside. **Developing something together is easier when continuing remains a free choice.** The finished piece can already serve you, although further possibilities surround it. You can appreciate what you achieved and choose another step according to today’s wishes, without proving the value of every earlier evening.

The difficulty starts with the thought that so much investment makes stopping impossible. You add effort to justify past effort and notice less whether continuing still appeals. Disagreeing with a new idea can feel ungrateful towards your shared work. Recognising that something is sufficient preserves its value and restores your right to choose how to spend the next free evening.
